evidence.source: 漢字ペディア (Japan Kanji Aptitude Testing Foundation; citing Kadokawa Shin Jigen)
evidence.text: The dictionary analyzes 住 as a phono-semantic graph: 人 plus the phonetic 主, with a stated sound progression 主 (シユ) → (チユ). It gives the sense development as ‘stand still in one place,’ extended to ‘live/reside.’ This is a dictionary account, not direct evidence for the date of the formation or earliest use.
evidence.title: 住 | 漢字一字 | 漢字ペディア

evidence.source: 漢字ペディア (Japan Kanji Aptitude Testing Foundation; citing Kadokawa Shin Jigen)
evidence.text: Records Japanese on-reading ジュウ, kun-readings すむ・すまう and とどまる, and meanings ‘reside/live,’ ‘dwelling,’ ‘resident,’ and ‘remain/stop.’ These are dictionary senses, not a dated chronology.
evidence.title: 住 | 漢字一字 | 漢字ペディア

evidence.text: Identifies 住 as 形声, 从人、主声, with ‘停留’ as its stated basic sense. Cited examples include 《后汉书·蓟子训传》‘蓟先生小住’ and other histories for staying, followed by examples of ‘stop’ and later literary attestations of ‘reside.’ The page does not establish that its listed examples are the earliest attestations.
evidence.title: 住 zhù - 汉典

evidence.source: 漢字データベース (Academia Sinica)
evidence.text: Lists senses including stop, remain, reside, verbal complement uses, ‘straight,’ borrowing/通用 with 駐 for stationing troops, surname, and a variant of 往. The page gives no dated citations here, so it does not determine the order or connection of these senses. Its separate listing of ‘住通駐’ is a lexical/graph relation and does not make 主 a whole-graph loan.
evidence.title: 漢字「住」：基本資料

evidence.field: Old Chinese and Middle Chinese readings
evidence.text: The published Baxter–Sagart table gives 主 zhǔ, MC tsyuX, OC *toʔ (‘master; host’), and separately gives 住 zhù, MC drjuH, OC *dro(ʔ)-s (‘stop (v.)’). These are the source’s readings in its own system. The local baxtersagart.tsv row supplied for 住 agrees exactly on zhù, drjuH, *dro(ʔ)-s, gloss and GSR 0129g; no local 主 row was supplied or inspected, so the table’s online 主 entry is cited independently. Similarity in the OC forms supports the plausibility of a phonetic relationship, but this transcription alone does not prove the graph’s formation date or the phonetic history.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.field: Old Chinese and Middle Chinese readings
evidence.text: For 主, the published table gives Mandarin zhǔ, MC tsyuX, OC *toʔ (‘master; host’). This is an independently checked reading for the proposed phonetic component, not a host-only reading transferred to 住. Compare the separately cited 住 entry for the relevant within-system comparison.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

evidence.field: 主声与住的历史音系资料
evidence.text: The entry reports 住 with Middle Chinese fanqie-based categories, including 澄母 and 知母 readings, and cites Old Chinese categories from Huang Kan and Wang Li. The available page does not provide 主’s corresponding rows in those systems, so it cannot by itself establish a same-system historical comparison. This is a gap; do not merge these categorical reconstructions with Baxter–Sagart notation.
evidence.title: 住 zhù - 汉典

evidence.source: 汪维辉, 汉语词汇史漫谈 | 古代人如何“居住”
evidence.text: This account identifies a passage in the early medical text 《灵枢经·邪客》, ‘邪气恶血固不得住留；住留则伤筋络,’ as an early known example of 住, and says late Han–Three Kingdoms texts use it more often for stopping or remaining (including combinations such as 住车、住马、住船、住军). It distinguishes this early ‘remain/stop’ use from the later or separately documented dwelling sense. The accessible page does not give a manuscript date for the cited 《灵枢经》 line, and the cited text’s transmission history prevents treating the quoted phrase alone as a securely dated earliest graph attestation.
evidence.title: 汉语词汇史漫谈 | 汪维辉：古代人如何“居住”

evidence.source: 高婉瑜, 漢文佛典的動詞「住」與「著」
evidence.text: The 2010 article summarizes 《漢語大詞典》 as listing ‘remain/stop’ and ‘reside’ among 住’s senses and characterizes the verb broadly as durative remaining at a place or thing. It discusses extensive Buddhist-canon usage in translated texts. This supports later semantic range and usage, not an ancient graphic origin or earliest attestation.
evidence.title: 漢文佛典的動詞「住」與「著」

evidence.source: 中國哲學書電子化計劃 (Chinese Text Project)
evidence.text: The dictionary page lists 住 in 宋本《廣韻》 and gives the fanqie 持遇 and 中句 (also 長句) readings. These are later lexicographic attestations of pronunciations, not formation evidence. The page’s cited historical works and senses are heterogeneous; they should not be read as a chronological gloss list.
evidence.title: 住 - 中國哲學書電子化計劃

gaps: No dated oracle-bone, bronze, or excavated manuscript form for 住 was verified. The phonosemantic analysis is attested in modern reference works, but the graph’s formation date and graphic development remain undocumented here.

The retrieved 《靈樞經·邪客》 example is a candidate early use for ‘remain/stop’; a securely dated manuscript or edition was not inspected. The earliest attestations of separate ‘stop,’ ‘reside,’ and ‘lodge’ senses therefore remain open.

主’s exact ancient depicted referent and earliest pronunciation were not independently established. Since the proposed 主 role is as a sound component within 住 rather than a whole-graph loan dependent on naming a depicted tool/object, that uncertainty does not itself disprove the phonetic analysis.

Local Baxter–Sagart material was provided for 住 only; the local 主 row was unavailable in the packet, so its reading claim relies on the inspected published Baxter–Sagart table, not a claimed local table check.

Official Unihan character-specific pages for U+4F4F and U+4E3B both failed in the browser tool. The provided local kMandarin row verifies zhù for 住 only; 主’s exact current Unihan kMandarin reading remains externally unverified.

Baxter–Sagart’s *toʔ for 主 and *dro(ʔ)-s for 住 differ from the dossier’s Wiktionary attributions *tjoʔ and *tos/*dos. These systems and claims should not be merged: the local 住 row confirms Baxter–Sagart’s *dro(ʔ)-s, while the relation of competing reconstructions requires separate source-specific treatment.

No verified source here establishes graphic corruption or a nonchronological variant for the main 住 form. The Ministry of Education variant dictionary search result mentions a 往/住 variant relation and an alternate graph structure, but that specific side entry was not opened/verified closely enough to transfer it to the main character’s formation account.
